invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if value is null, so at exit value must be non-null.
If a node is found, it has the given value; if not found, result is null.
If a node is found, its value must not be null, because value is tested for null and findNode(rootNodes, value) should only match non-null values.
If a node is returned, its value must equal the searched value.
